The <b>Green Prince</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Wanderers|wandering NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. A [[Verdanians|Verdanian]] former prince of [[Verdania]], he has been locked away.

== Background ==
The Green Prince is the former ruler of [[Verdania]], which he ruled alongside his partner.<ref>[[Clover Dancers]] [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Dual princes of old Verdania, beloved by their subjects for their grace and for the ballet of death they delivered upon outsiders."</i></ref> His partner gave his life to become the model for the [[Cogwork Dancers]] in an attempt to save Verdania from ruin.<ref>Green Prince: <i>"The dancers... they were the last free act of my partner... Always hopeful. Always naive. His whole he gave, in desperate trade to see our own caves left safe. His shell and soul became the mould."</i></ref> He is the only surviving Verdanian.<ref>Green Prince: <i>"Pharloom's end approaches, but my caves, these caves, fell to fate long before. Of that fair land, I am the last..."</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
The Green Prince is first encountered in a locked cage in [[Sinner's Road]]. The lock can be opened with a [[Simple Key (Silksong)|Simple Key]].

After he is freed, the Green Prince moves to a long hallway west of [[Citadel Spa]], only if [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] has first completed the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Choral Chambers|enemy gauntlet]] there.

After the [[Cogwork Dancers]] in the [[Cogwork Core]] are defeated, the Green Prince moves to the short hallway to the left of the Cogwork Dancers' arena if Hornet has visited [[Songclave]] and has seen the Green Prince in the previous room west of Citadel Spa, or if [[Act 3]] has started.

In Act 3, after speaking to the Green Prince in the Cogwork Dancers' arena,<ref group=Source><code>Clover Entry Gate (1)</code> in <code>greymoor_15b.bundle</code> checks flags <code>GreenPrinceLocation</code> and <code>blackThreadWorld</code>.</ref> he can be found in the caves of Verdania, which is accessible from the east of [[Craw Lake]] in [[Greymoor]]. He brings the shell of one of the Cogwork Dancers with him, and mourns at the image of his lover. Playing the [[Elegy of the Deep]] next to him sends Hornet to [[Lost Verdania]]. The Green Prince can be found at many different places throughout the area. After activating at least 12 memory orbs,<ref group=Source>FSM <code>palace_control - Control</code> in <code>clover_10.bundle</code> checks <code>CloverMemoryOrbsCollectedTarget</code>.</ref> the entrance to the palace appears in upper centre of Lost Verdania, in the place where the Green Prince used to sit. Inside the palace, the Green Prince can be found standing in front of the throne. Upon approaching, he challenges Hornet to a fight for trespassing his memory.

After defeating him, Hornet leaves Lost Verdania and returns to the entrance of current Verdania. The Green Prince can be found lying deceased next to the shell of the Cogwork Dancer. Upon returning to this location with the [[Everbloom]], clovers can be seen growing around the two.<ref group=Source><code>GameManager.TimePasses()</code> sets flag <code>cloverDancerRegrowth</code></ref>

| Title3_Dialogue1 = <b>First conversation:</b><br>
I'd hoped to never step these hateful halls, yet here I stand, as all those hapless bugs before.<br>
{{HTalk|You've journeyed far from that damp cell, tall bug. If you would oppose the minions of this Citadel, you have my respect.}}<br>

| Title3_Event2 = In the [[Cogwork Dancers]]' arena
| Title3_Dialogue2 = <b>First conversation:</b><br>
You… So, it is done… My wish granted before ever I arrived…<br>
{{HTalk|The bronze pair that danced this chamber, it is clear, tall bug, how closely they mimicked your shell. Was it you who provided their inspiration?}}<br>
Not I, warrior. For this place, my heart holds only loathing…<br>
The dancers… they were the last free act of my partner… Always hopeful. Always naive.<br>
His whole he gave, in desperate trade to see our own caves left safe. His shell and soul became the mould.<br>
So long, I dared not visit… Even as our lands fell to thread and ruin… Instead I wasted, a coward caged, too weak to witness his grace bound in parody so cruel.<br>
{{HTalk|Take some solace, tall bug. His soul is now free from that shell of iron, and the fate that befell your lands, this Citadel too has been claimed full by it.}}<br>
Aye… Slim consolation, warrior, now that everything I loved is lost…
<hr/>
<b>Exhausted dialogue:</b><br>
My wish is granted… and now everything I love is lost…

== Location ==
The Green Prince can be first encountered in a locked cage in [[Sinner's Road]].

After being freed from his cage, the Green Prince can be found in a long hallway west of [[Citadel Spa]], only if [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] has first completed the enemy gauntlet there.

After the [[Cogwork Dancers]] in the [[Cogwork Core]] are defeated, the Green Prince moves to the short hallway to the left of the Cogwork Dancers' arena if Hornet has visited [[Songclave]] and has seen the Green Prince in the previous room west of Citadel Spa, or if Act 3 has started.

In Act 3, after speaking to the Green Prince in the Cogwork Dancers' arena, he can be found in the caves of Verdania, which is accessible from the east of [[Craw Lake]] in [[Greymoor]].

After playing the [[Elegy of the Deep]] and entering [[Lost Verdania]], the Green Prince can be found at many different places throughout the area. After activating at least 12 memory orbs, the entrance to the palace appears in upper centre of Lost Verdania. Inside the palace, the Green Prince can be found standing in front of the throne.

After defeating him, the Green Prince can be found lying motionless next to the shell of the Cogwork Dancer at the entrance of current Verdania.
